definitions.full: H2855. Chethlon חֶתְלֹן proper name, of a location , on the extreme northern boundary of Israel territory (in Ezekiel's conception), only ׳דֶּרֶךְ(ֿ)ח Ezek 47:15 ; 48:1 ; modern „eitela nearly two hours from sea-coast, according to Furrer ZPV viii, 27 .
